title: Psychology Facts
hook: What happens when you swap cash for a card?
facts: Paying with cash makes the cost feel more *real*.
In 2001, Prelec and Simester auctioned Celtics tickets to *MIT students*.
Those paying by card bid up to *twice* as much.
Plastic hides the pain, so spending feels *lighter*.
outro: Swap cash for a card, and spending changes.
